title: Jewelled Malaysian Minari Dumplings
description: Resinous, pillowy meal-prep Malaysian dish featuring minari, dum, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: Dumpling Wrappers (Vegan)
ingredients.notes: Available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Himalayan pink salt for best flavor

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine lemongrass, ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, and a pinch of salt to make a smooth paste.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the lemongrass-ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the sliced minari and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil.
Cook the dumpling wrappers according to package instructions.
Once cooked, remove the dumplings from the water and add them to the skillet with the minari mixture.
Toss the dumplings in the skillet to coat with the flavorful liquid.
Serve the jewelled Malaysian minari dumplings hot, garnished with chopped cilantro, mint, and a drizzle of rice vinegar (if using).
